sentences.text: ON THE 11 th OF DECEMBER, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 51596 of 2024  SAMEER  Versus  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS  Appearance:
Ms Drishti Rawal - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Amit Raval - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/Sta  Shri Aman Yadav - Advocate for the respondent [R-2]/obj  ORDER

This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. Act,2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.254/2024 registered at Police Station - Susner,, District Agar Malwa (M.P.) for an offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in judicial custody since 08.11.2024.
As per the case of prosecution, victim aged around 17 years 02 months reported to SHO, P.S. Susner Distt. Agar Malwa that her family members had engaged her with one Sahil R/o Kanad.
She had got friendly with her neighbor Sameer S/o Babu Khan Mansuri.
When Sameer came to know about her engagement with Sahil, Sameer proposed to marry her.
Sameer also informed Sahil about their relationship, due to which her engagement was broken.
Thereafter, she and Sameer started meeting each other.
Sameer used to call her at his home and had sexual relations with her on the promise of marriage.
On NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35200 2 MCRC-51596-2024 17.06.2024, Sameer called her to his uncle Sultan's house and committed rape on her.
When she asked Sameer to marry, he refused to marry her and threatened to kill her, if she inform anybody about their relationship.
On 08.09.2024, she informed her parents about the incident.
After discussion with all the family members, she had come to report as Sameer has refused to marry her.
On such allegations, P.S. Susner registered FIR at Crime No. 254/2024 for offences punishable u/S 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 506 of IPC & Sec 5L/6 POCSO Act against the applicant - Sameer.
The victim was forwarded for medico-legal examination.

Statements of victim were recorded under sections Sameer vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190884586/
1 180 and 183 BNSS, 2023.

entities.label: PROVISION

sentences.text: Applicant - Sameer was arrested on 08.11.2024.
He is in judicial custody ever since.
On completion of investigation, final report was submitted.

Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application,
contends that the applicant is falsely implicated in this matter under the pressure of family members of the victim.
It is case of teenage romance between two young persons.
When their relationship turned sour and could not culminate into marriage.
false allegation of rape were made against the applicant.
No offence, as alleged, is committed by the applicant.
Learned counsel further submits that applicant is aged 20 years and he is pursuing his Bachelor's Degree in Computer.
There is no likelihood of absconsion leaving his home, family and studies.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant.
The trial would take time to conclude.
Therefore, the applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State ably assisted by the counsel for Victim oppose the bail application on the ground of gravity of the alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:35200 3 MCRC-51596-2024 Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall circumstances of the case, having regard to young age of the applicant, but without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant- Sameer S/o Babu Khan Mansuri shall be released on bail in connection with the Crime as stated in para - 1 of this order, upon furnishing personal bond and surety bond of amount, as may be considered appropriate by the Trial Court/the Committal Court for compliance with conditions, as may be imposed by such Court, to secure presence of the applicant for the trial under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973/Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial.
However, in case of breach of any of the preconditions of bail, the concerned Court may consider, on merit, cancellation of bail without any impediment of this order.
The concerned Court shall get the conditions reproduced on the personal bond by the accused and on surety bond by the surety concerned.

If any of them is unable to write, the scribe shall certify that he had explained the conditions to the concerned accused or the surety.
C.C.
as per rules.
(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE sh
